description: This file defines a Ruby script that extends the String class with methods for line splitting and whitespace trimming, and contains a module 'Protodoc' with a nested 'Environment' module and a 'Preprocessor' class. The 'Preprocessor' class reads a template file, processes it with ERB, and outputs the processed result with whitespace trimming. When executed directly, it initializes a Preprocessor with a filename argument and outputs the processed template.
external_files: the file passed as argument during execution
the file specified by @filename during processing

classes.name: String
classes.description: An extension of the core String class adding methods to split into lines and strip trailing whitespace from each line.

classes.name: Protodoc
classes.description: A namespace module serving as a container for the 'Environment' module and the 'Preprocessor' class.

classes.name: Protodoc::Environment
classes.description: Module providing an 'include' method to inline the contents of specified files, processed via the Preprocessor.

classes.name: Protodoc::Preprocessor
classes.description: Class responsible for reading a template file, processing it with ERB templating, and outputting the result with whitespace at line ends trimmed.

methods.name: String#lines
methods.description: Splits the string into an array of lines.

methods.name: String#strip_whitespace_at_line_ends
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace from each line in the string.

methods.name: Protodoc::Environment#include
methods.description: Includes and concatenates the contents of given filenames after processing via the Preprocessor.

methods.name: Protodoc::Preprocessor#initialize
methods.description: Constructor that reads a filename, creates an ERB template from its contents.

methods.name: Protodoc::Preprocessor#to_s
methods.description: Processes the ERB template with the current binding and returns the resulting string with whitespace trimmed.
